question: Where is the first edition of the Indo–Republic of Korea bilateral naval exercise, IN–RoKN, being conducted in October 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Busan Naval Base, South Korea.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Navy (IN) and the Republic of Korea Navy (RoKN) have commenced their first bilateral naval exercise, IN–RoKN, on 13th October 2025 at the Busan Naval Base, South Korea.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **IN–RoKN 2025 marks the first-ever bilateral naval exercise between India and South Korea, enhancing maritime cooperation and regional stability.**
 
• **The exercise consists of two phases — the Harbour Phase for professional exchanges and the Sea Phase for complex operational coordination.**
 
• **The Indian Navy is represented by INS Sahyadri, a Shivalik-class stealth frigate, while the Republic of Korea Navy is represented by ROKS Gyeongnam.**
 
• **The event reinforces India–South Korea’s shared commitment to peace, security, and a rules-based order in the Indo-Pacific region.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• INS Sahyadri__

 __
 
• Commissioned in 2012 and part of the Eastern Fleet under Eastern Naval Command, Visakhapatnam
 
• Shivalik-class stealth frigate — fully indigenously designed and built
 
• Equipped with advanced weaponry and sensors for multi-role naval operations
 
 
 
• Exercise Structure__
 __
 
• **Harbour Phase:** Cross-deck visits, professional exchanges, and camaraderie-building activities
 
• **Sea Phase:** Tactical manoeuvres, air defence, and interoperability drills between INS Sahyadri and ROKS Gyeongnam
 
 
 
• Strategic Significance__
 
 
• Strengthens bilateral defence cooperation and operational synergy
 
• Supports freedom of navigation and maritime security in the Indo-Pacific
 
• Reflects India’s growing naval presence and commitment to regional partnerships
